CREATE TABLE `asset_opportunity_matches` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`asset_id` int NOT NULL,
	`opportunity_id` int NOT NULL,
	`match_score` int DEFAULT 0,
	`synergy_notes` text,
	`estimated_revenue` int DEFAULT 0,
	`status` enum('suggested','accepted','rejected','completed') DEFAULT 'suggested',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`completed_at` timestamp,
	CONSTRAINT `asset_opportunity_matches_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `circle_members` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`circle_id` int NOT NULL,
	`user_id` int NOT NULL,
	`role` enum('founder','member','advisor') DEFAULT 'member',
	`contribution_percentage` int DEFAULT 0,
	`joined_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`status` enum('active','inactive') DEFAULT 'active',
	CONSTRAINT `circle_members_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `marketplace_opportunities` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`creator_id` int NOT NULL,
	`title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`asset_types_needed` text,
	`budget_min` int DEFAULT 0,
	`budget_max` int DEFAULT 0,
	`timeline` varchar(100),
	`status` enum('open','matched','in_progress','completed') DEFAULT 'open',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`deadline` timestamp,
	CONSTRAINT `marketplace_opportunities_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `sovereign_circles` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`founder_id` int NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`member_count` int DEFAULT 1,
	`total_combined_value` int DEFAULT 0,
	`governance_type` enum('democratic','founder_led','consensus') DEFAULT 'founder_led',
	`status` enum('active','inactive') DEFAULT 'active',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `sovereign_circles_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `user_vaults` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`user_id` int NOT NULL,
	`vault_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`bio` text,
	`total_assets_count` int DEFAULT 0,
	`estimated_annual_value` int DEFAULT 0,
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `user_vaults_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `vault_assets` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`vault_id` int NOT NULL,
	`asset_type` enum('skill','content','ip','network','data') NOT NULL,
	`name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`category` varchar(100),
	`monetization_potential` enum('high','medium','low') DEFAULT 'medium',
	`market_demand_score` int DEFAULT 0,
	`competitive_advantage` int DEFAULT 0,
	`base_value` int DEFAULT 0,
	`unique_multiplier` varchar(10) DEFAULT '1.0',
	`estimated_annual_revenue` int DEFAULT 0,
	`revenue_history` text,
	`status` enum('active','inactive','pending_monetization') DEFAULT 'active',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `vault_assets_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `wealth_agreements` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`type` enum('asset_sale','revenue_share','partnership','licensing') NOT NULL,
	`party_a_id` int NOT NULL,
	`party_b_id` int NOT NULL,
	`asset_id` int,
	`opportunity_id` int,
	`terms` text,
	`revenue_split` text,
	`contract_hash` varchar(255),
	`status` enum('draft','signed','active','completed','disputed') DEFAULT 'draft',
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`signed_at` timestamp,
	`expires_at` timestamp,
	CONSTRAINT `wealth_agreements_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
CREATE TABLE `wealth_transactions` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`agreement_id` int,
	`from_user_id` int NOT NULL,
	`to_user_id` int NOT NULL,
	`amount` int NOT NULL,
	`asset_id` int,
	`transaction_type` enum('payment','royalty','revenue_share') NOT NULL,
	`status` enum('pending','completed','failed') DEFAULT 'pending',
	`blockchain_hash` varchar(255),
	`createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`completed_at` timestamp,
	CONSTRAINT `wealth_transactions_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
